scope: Same five DOCX inputs; alternating five fresh processes for the pre-cache list-structure wheel and installed glyph-width-cache wheel. Same interpreter and dependencies, no concurrent full test or rendering jobs. Raw stages and RSS retained. Not a tagged-PDF, shaping or native-office benchmark.

visual_comparison.method: PyMuPDF: every page, default-resolution pixmap samples, words with coordinates, vector drawings and image metadata hashed independently. Compares pre-cache and cached installed wheels; equal byte lengths do not imply identical PDF bytes.
